tool.name: SAM31TextPromptTrackingTool
tool.summary: Find and track objects in a local video with SAM 3.1. Choose a video, prompt, output folder and run name, then run a short trial or the full video. CSV is enabled by default. Pixel-space feature-class export is optional.
tool.usage: Tracking advances every frame. Larger detection intervals reduce searches for new objects but delay discovery. Feature-class polygons are in video pixels, not geographic coordinates. Annotated video is a derived review copy without KLV/MISB metadata. The source video is not rewritten. A trial limits processed frames, but first-use model preparation still applies.

param.name: in_video
param.dialogReference: Local video file. Local HLS/DASH inputs require their segment files.

param.name: text_prompt
param.dialogReference: Describe the objects to find, for example truck or person.

param.name: output_folder
param.dialogReference: Existing folder for generated CSV, annotated video and optional geodatabase outputs.

param.name: model_package
param.dialogReference: Select a local compatible SAM 3.1 .dlpk. Verified checkpoint and vocabulary assets are cached per user. The toolbox uses its shipped runtime; no files are uploaded.

param.name: run_name
param.dialogReference: Base name for generated outputs. Use letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter. Use a new name to preserve earlier runs.

param.name: run_mode
param.dialogReference: Full video processes to the end. Short trial processes the first Trial Frames frames.

param.name: max_frames
param.dialogReference: Number of initial frames to process in Short trial mode; default 90. Ignored in Full video mode. Model preparation time is unchanged.

param.name: export_csv
param.dialogReference: Save tracking attributes as a portable CSV table. Enabled by default.

param.name: save_annotated_video
param.dialogReference: Save a visual review video with annotations. Disabling reduces drawing and encoding work. The derived video has no KLV/MISB metadata.

param.name: export_features
param.dialogReference: Optionally save bounding-box polygons in a file geodatabase. Coordinates are video pixels, not real-world map locations.

param.name: csv_path
param.dialogReference: Generated from Output Folder and Run Name. Override only when a different CSV path is needed.

param.name: annotated_video_path
param.dialogReference: Generated MP4 review-video path. Must be different from the input video and other outputs.

param.name: out_feature_class
param.dialogReference: Optional pixel-space output inside a file geodatabase. Not georeferenced. Disabled unless feature-class export is selected.

param.name: detection_interval
param.dialogReference: Frames between searches for new objects. Larger values reduce detection work but delay discovery. Existing objects track every frame.

param.name: max_objects
param.dialogReference: Maximum objects tracked simultaneously, up to 16. More than 16 total IDs may be created over the video.

param.name: confidence_threshold
param.dialogReference: Detection confidence threshold from 0 to 1. Higher values reject more candidates but may miss difficult objects.

param.name: lost_grace_frames
param.dialogReference: Missing frames to retain an occluded object's ID before termination. Zero terminates on the first missing observation.

param.name: out_of_frame_grace_frames
param.dialogReference: Missing frames to retain an object last seen at an image edge before termination.

param.name: min_valid_mask_area
param.dialogReference: Minimum mask size in pixels for a valid visible observation.

param.name: min_track_confidence
param.dialogReference: Optional additional confidence threshold for visible tracking observations. Blank uses the tracker threshold.

param.name: iou_threshold
param.dialogReference: Overlap threshold used to match detections to existing tracks and avoid duplicates.

param.name: centroid_threshold
param.dialogReference: Maximum normalized center distance used for duplicate matching.

param.name: hide_box_when_lost
param.dialogReference: Lost tracks have null positions and are not drawn as stale boxes.

param.name: show_lost_status
param.dialogReference: Show a small status panel listing temporarily lost or out-of-frame tracks.
